Welfare.title: Animal Welfare & Quality Charter
Welfare.subtitle: Pawelium was founded to put animal health, dignity, and European breeding transparency first.

pillars.pedigreeDesc: All listings adhere to official national kennel and feline clubs (LOF in France, LOOF for cats, FCI partner associations). Lineages are documented and verifiable.
pillars.vetDesc: Mandatory multi-point health check, European pet passport, ISO microchip implantation, and comprehensive core vaccinations prior to departure.
pillars.familyDesc: Puppies and kittens grow up in home environments with human interaction, sensory enrichment, and daily care — never industrial breeding facilities.
pillars.weaningDesc: No animal leaves their mother before reaching the statutory age of at least 8 to 10 weeks, ensuring biological and psychological weaning.

audits.title: Our Zero-Tolerance Breeder Audits
audits.p1: Every partner breeder in our European network is subjected to multi-point compliance audits. We evaluate breeding density, maternity hygiene, maternal rest cycles between litters, and early puppy/kitten sensory exposure.
audits.p2: We strictly bar commercial brokerages, third-party intermediaries, and industrial breeding mills. All parents have verifiable genetic clearances against breed-specific hereditary conditions.

transport.title: Humane & Climate-Controlled Transport
transport.desc: Transport is conducted exclusively by licensed European pet couriers operating under EU Regulation 1/2005 on the protection of animals during transport. Vehicles are air-conditioned, sanitized, and equipped with fresh water systems and veterinary first-aid supplies.
